about.label: About me
about.text:
I'm a fullstack software developer and have spent the last ~2 years at Intelbras, building applications across the backend and frontend — architecture decisions, APIs, and web interfaces — mainly with Go, React, JavaScript, and C.

I hold a degree in Telecommunications Engineering from IFSC, which gave me a solid foundation in networking and communication protocols. Over my career, I've also applied that knowledge to IP telephony products and embedded Linux.
